subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract and raw-media security policy?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix crosses WebChat UX, Gateway payload shape, provider/model capability routing, provider egress, and security policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class chat video input
options.body: Define the generic WebChat/Gateway/model/provider contract with validation, limits, fallback, and docs before landing a replacement implementation.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding only
options.body: Document and improve the existing video.description tool-style path without adding native chat/video content blocks yet.

options.title: Start provider-specific first
options.body: Use provider-owned plugin implementations such as MiniMax, Qwen, or Moonshot to prove native video semantics before promoting a generic core contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class chat video input
recommendation.body: Define the generic WebChat/Gateway/model/provider contract with validation, limits, fallback, and docs before landing a replacement implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account provided the clearest existing routing context on the issue discussion and can arbitrate the product/security direction before code work resumes.
